summary: Create a NativeImage from a filesystem path.

target.notes: Requires an image codec/native image wrapper, not Chromium.

semantics.failure: returns empty image rather than throwing for unreadable/invalid image in common Electron semantics

caveats: Image codec support and scale-factor resource conventions are platform/backend dependent.

tests.name: load image
tests.expected_behavior: returns a NativeImage-compatible object for a valid image

tests.name: invalid path
tests.expected_behavior: returns an empty NativeImage-compatible object rather than translating blindly to File.ReadAllBytes exception semantics
